g.text: River structure associations after environmental adjustment
Station-equal regression; controls include ecology, climate, sampling, geography and HUC2. Bootstrap intervals condition on the fixed classification.
Thin intervals additionally resample HUC4 basins. Open diamonds omit local hydrology. Bars: equal-fold mean; connected dots: folds, ridge α=10.
Classes use all available physical geometry, without DOC; this is exploratory association analysis, not independent external validation.
